definitions.short: a devourer ; specifically, the young locust
definitions.full: H3218. yeleq יֶ֫לֶק noun masculine Nahum 3:16 a kind of locust , absolute יֶלֶק 3:16 5 t.; יָ֑לֶק Joel 1:4 2 t.; — always collective: a. as devouring || חָסִיל אַרְבֶּה, גָּזָם, , Joel 1:4 (twice in verse); 2:25 ; || אַרְבֶּה Psa 105:34 (of Egyptian plague), compare Nahum 3:15 a (but strike out We). b. in simile of multitude of men Nahum 3:15 b Jer 51:14 ; of horses 51:27 ( סָמָר יֶלֶק ). c. in simile of scattering and disappearing Nahum 3:16 . יַלְקוּט see לקט .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to lick up;
